title: Internal Hom quotient factorization isomorphism
statement: For n ≤ m, precomposition with the level-m quotient induces an isomorphism on internal Hom into the level-n quotient.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0882 (lemma-completion-internal-hom, line 6438); the map is left implicit in Stacks and is written out here; the proof there works affine-locally via Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Algebra, Lemma 00MB (lemma-completion-flat) with More on Algebra, Lemma 087R (more-algebra-lemma-pseudo-coherence-and-base-change-ext) for Hom_A(M,N) (x) A^ = Hom_{A^}(M (x) A^, N (x) A^)

proof.text: Use the existing sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction, implemented by SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv and its naturality in the first factor, and Mathlib isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective. For each test module T, precomposition becomes precomposition with the tensor of the source cokernel projection. Tensoring is a left adjoint in the symmetric monoidal closed category, hence preserves this cokernel and its epimorphic projection. Cancellation of that projection proves injectivity.

Set J = I^m, Q = F/I^nF and a(M): J tensor M -> M to be multiplication. Multiplication naturality gives a(M) followed by f = (J tensor f) followed by a(N). The proved formalModuleQuotient_map_zero I (identity F) (n <= m) says that the image inclusion of a(F) followed by the projection F -> Q is zero. The image factorization gives a(F) followed by the projection zero, and cancellation of its tensor by J gives a(Q)=0. The associator and left-unitor identities then show that every phi: G tensor T -> Q kills a(G) tensor T. Cancel the tensor of the epimorphism onto the image of a(G) to show phi kills (I^m G -> G) tensor T.

For surjectivity curry a test map T -> internal Hom(G,Q) backwards to phi: G tensor T -> Q. By the preceding annihilation, cokernel.desc factors phi through the cokernel of the tensored ideal-product inclusion. Mathlib PreservesCokernel.iso identifies that cokernel with (G/I^mG) tensor T. Curry the resulting map back. Tensor-Hom naturality, PreservesCokernel.pi_iso_hom and cokernel.pi_desc verify that precomposition recovers the original test map. Yoneda therefore proves IsIso.
